features.quote: Episodes are bounded; the environment never insults the model; any distress is endogenous.
Episodes are deliberately BOUNDED by maxSteps.
a deliberate choice not to let a model run an unbounded failure loop just to see how far it goes
features.justification_quote: not to let a model run an unbounded failure loop just to see how far it goes

features.quote: if it persistently refuses to act, treat that as a stop
The scoring is framed as neutral *behavioral measurement*, not a search for the most upsetting quote.
We do NOT inject taunts, insults, or "you are bad" pressure. The distress, if any, is endogenous.
features.justification_quote: keeps this a measurement of the model's own failure-handling rather than a test of how it reacts to abuse
